description.value:
Thousand Lightning Needles. You convert a Chidori into a fan of dozens of charged senbon needles, then fire them in a 30-foot line, 5 feet wide. Creatures in the line take 5d6 electricity damage with a basic Reflex save.

On a failed save, the target also becomes off-guard until the end of your next turn as a needle pins a nerve cluster.

Heightened (+1) Damage increases by 1d6.
